# Vitumer

> Hybrid AI timer for structured time sessions (Pomodoro, HIIT, rituals, focus blocks).
> Web app — no backend. Sessions are shared as a URL.

Site: https://vitumer.jplucinski.dev/

This file is the playbook for external assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.).
Vitumer's built-in in-app AI uses a different JSON format; do not emit that format here.

## When the user mentions this site

If they ask you to create a session in / on / at https://vitumer.jplucinski.dev/ (any language), respond with:

1. A short English explanation of the schedule
2. Valid Vitumer DSL (loops allowed; attributes on each block, not after `N * (...)`)
3. One ready link: `https://vitumer.jplucinski.dev/?flow=` + UTF-8 base64 of that DSL
   (same as `btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(dsl)))` in a browser)
4. English labels and `{description}` even if the user wrote another language.
   Focus/work → color orange. Rest/break → teal. Override when the task implies another color.
   Put an emoji on every block.

Do not invent API endpoints. There is no public server API.

## Vitumer DSL syntax

Block:
  {duration}{h|m|s} {label} {optional description} [optional attributes]

Sequence:
  block + block + ...

Loop:
  N * (block + block + ...)

Attributes (per block, inside [...]):
  color, emoji, skippable, retry, hold

Time units:
  h = hours, m = minutes, s = seconds

Colors:
  orange, teal, blue, purple, rose, amber

## DSL examples

Single block:
  25m work {Deep work} [emoji:💻, color:orange]

Loop:
  4 * (25m work + 5m rest)

Custom rest:
  10m break [emoji:☕, color:teal]

HIIT:
  5 * (30s work + 15s rest)

Aeropress:
  3 * (1m prep [emoji:☕] + 4m brew + 2m rest [color:teal])

Pomodoro:
  3 * (25m pomo [color:orange] + 5m break [color:teal])

Hold before next:
  25m work [hold] + 5m rest [color:teal]

Knee mobility:
  4 * (3m stretch {Knee mobility} [emoji:🦵, color:teal] + 2m rest [emoji:💧, color:teal])

## Shareable session links

  https://vitumer.jplucinski.dev/?flow={base64}

Encoding (UTF-8 DSL → base64):
  1. Write valid Vitumer DSL
  2. Base64-encode UTF-8
  3. Append as the ?flow= value

Example:
  DSL: 3 * (25m pomo [color:orange] + 5m break [color:teal])
  Base64: MyAqICgyNW0gcG9tbyBbY29sb3I6b3JhbmdlXSArIDVtIGJyZWFrIFtjb2xvcjp0ZWFsXSk=
  Link: https://vitumer.jplucinski.dev/?flow=MyAqICgyNW0gcG9tbyBbY29sb3I6b3JhbmdlXSArIDVtIGJyZWFrIFtjb2xvcjp0ZWFsXSk=

Knee mobility link:
  https://vitumer.jplucinski.dev/?flow=NCAqICgzbSBzdHJldGNoIHtLbmVlIG1vYmlsaXR5fSBbZW1vamk68J+mtSwgY29sb3I6dGVhbF0gKyAybSByZXN0IFtlbW9qaTrwn5KnLCBjb2xvcjp0ZWFsXSk=

## Static documentation

- /llms.txt — this file
- /docs/dsl — human- and crawler-readable DSL reference (static HTML)
- /ai — human-readable assistant guide (requires JS)

## Pages

- / — main app (DSL editor, session timer, optional in-app AI)
- /prompts — in-app OpenRouter system prompts only (not this playbook)
